summary: Master legal risk management and contract literacy. Protect your organization from liability with our 5-day expert-led course. Enroll today.
lede: Legal awareness training for non-legal teams helps staff spot legal risks in routine business decisions. It covers reviewing vendor contracts, managing privacy and intellectual-property concerns, and preparing for workplace issues or disputes. Participants practice risk assessment, contract redlining, compliance checklists, and communicating legal risks so they can add suitable checkpoints to operational workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals who operate at the intersection of business operations and regulatory compliance, requiring them to make decisions with legal consequences.
modules: Technology and AI in Legal Operations
prerequisites: This intermediate-level course requires participants to have at least three years of experience in a management or specialist role where they handle contracts, vendor relationships, or personnel management. No prior legal training is required, but familiarity with your organization's internal compliance policies and standard contract templates is highly recommended to maximize the value of the practical exercises.
